avis.texte: This product has been purchased and tested, many times. Lol, and it has been approved as effective, it is my absolute favorite step #4 of my AM skincare routine. Thankvyou
I will continue to buy this. This serum has my skin glossy even toned and gives me a useful look. Please try.
Works wonderful with skin tone you will see difference in skin blemishes in 2 weeks .

I've been using Urban skin RX products for years!!! This vitamin c serum is my absolute favorite. The serum color has varied bottle to bottle but still effective at brightening. And I don't mind the smell honestly lol I just love the affordability of this brand and the types of ingredients used in each product. I have watched real results happen with the products!!!! Forever in love with USRX ❤️

I have only been using the serum for a short time so I can't tell yet if it will help fade my dark spots, but I was disappointed I got serum that appears to be oxidized (discolored) already. The accompanying paperwork says it will discolor with age so I'm not sure if I received old stock or not.

avis.titre: I could take it or leave it
avis.texte: First, it smells terrible. Think mushrooms growing out of smelly rubber. It does work though! I have boticed my dark spots getting lighter. So, I just use a few drops in my regular moisturizer to mask the smell. I read that it is made using fermented ingredients so i suppose the smell makes sense.

This serum is a must have for me. My skin has improved tremendously since i started using Urban Skin Rx products period. Since I started using this serum, people compliment my skin daily. I have nothing but good things to say about this product.

I love this stuff. It has dramatically faded several really large dark sun spots on my face as well as faded old acne marks. I had a large dark brown spot on the bridge of my nose and it completely disappeared after a few weeks and has not returned after several months. It makes my skin feel smooth, but I really only focus on the brightening properties. I use it at night after an exfoliating toner and then use a heavy moisturizer over it. It does smell bad, and it kind of sticky, I wouldn't use it during it the day, but it does what it says it's going to do and is very reasonably priced. I am on my 3rd bottle and will continue to repurchase.

Ive been using this product for years and recently pirchased a new bottle. I get they changed it because alot of people were complaining anout the smell but it used to work so good. When I used jt recently it just broke me out and the new formula is nkt as strong as the old one.

It smells and is sticky on the skin. However, it does leave a glowing finish and seems to minimize hyperpigmentation. Also, they've downsized from a . 75 ounce to a .5 ounce formula that's less potent or altered from the original formula for the same price. It's alright but, I may opt out and opt in for something with more for the same price like cocokinds serum.

Seems to minimize my pores and lighten my dark spots. It also gives me a nice glow finish and helps tone my skin. I bought the . 75 ounce bottle at the time and fell in love with this. I'm a bit disappointed that they've downsized to .5 ounces instead now and a bit pricey for that size. Why mess up a good thing?! Other than that it's amazing!
This smells like olive oil and feels so sticky. It made my face itch. World not recommend.

avis.titre: I do not like how it smells and feels on my skin
avis.texte: it's really sticky and stinky so I don't feel like using it ,so don't know it actually works

avis.titre: Not for Sensitive Skin & Horrible Scent
avis.texte: Let me start by saying that my skin is very sensitive, 48 years old, impacted with rosacea and additional intermittent eczema. That being said this product line is purported to be safe for sensitive reactive aged skin. Also let me say that the reaction I experienced with this product line was not retinol purging. I had been using IS Clinical Products for several years including their anti-aging retinol products. Unfortunately I used these products only twice and I dealt with a severe flare up of rosacea & eczema. So now this cream sits in my plastic tub that collects products I have purchased yet can't use. I can't comment on long-term effectiveness or if the products work as claimed by marketing jargon. One other thing. WHAT is with the horrible scent of this product line? If I hadn't had a hypersensitivity reaction to these products and even if they worked as marketed I wouldn't have repurchased any of these products because they smell horrible.

avis.titre: Gave me a lot of bumps
avis.texte: Only used jf for two days because most of the reviews are good but it left me face very irritated, dry, red, gave me a lot of bumps that i did not hage prior to using this

I'm impressed with the ingredients lineup in this formula - that's what caught my attention initially. I mean, not many (affordable) products have glutathione outside of Korea. The texture is really nice, too. Usually I find vitamin C serums to be greasy, but this seems to absorb without any film or residue. Again, I haven't found many vitamin C serums that perform well, have a palatable price point, and a nice texture. Usually I have to settle for two of the three. However, the smell is abhorrent. I'm not sure if it either dissipates after settling in, or if I just get used to it, but it doesn't linger forever, fortunately. It doesn't ruin the product for me, and I'd still recommend it, but that initial whiff was shocking. This would be a perfect 5 star product if not for the scent. Not everything needs to be free of added fragrance...

These comments about the amell are irrelevant. Not everything has to smell like a perfume store especially when you want something vegan and that WORKS! This product has helped my dark spots tremendously. Yea the smell isn't delicious, but it goes away once absorbed.

I just bought this about 2 weeks ago. Maybe I have a sensitive nose but the smell of this serum isnt pleasant. However, I do think it works. When its first applied, it almost feels sticky but then it settles into my face. Will keep using and hoping for good results
I looked serum that was delivered and realized that it is only half way filled. disappointing to know that you can't even get an item correctly. ver very very dissatisfied.

Honestly I saw results immediately. My skin ranges from oily to dry. I use this product combine with a few other products but I saw instant results using this product. I've very satisfied with the results.
I think the bottle I purchased is old bc the smell is atrocious and the color is quite yellow. I can't use it bc of the smell. :(

I would normally wait at least 30 days before postimg a review for a skincare product. I have used this Vitamin C serum a total of 4 times and I am already seeing results and I am very impressed!! I have been using vit c for a few years and my regular one was discontinued some time ago, and I've been searching for a new one since. I finally found it with this!! I will say that I had to acclimate my skin to this one, not sure if it's because of the kojic acid that's in it, or if it's where I'm just starting to go through menopause and my skin is out of whack…. The first time I used I got some stinging and redness so I waited two days before using it again. Then after my second time using it I waited one day until i was up to every day. I do not use this on my eyes because its just too drying on that area, specifically my eye lids. But now my skin is loving it and I don't have any stinging or redness and I have seen a huge improvement with the dark spots on my cheeks and the hyperpigmentation on my forehead. The serum does get tacky after it soaks in, but by the time I've applied my Q10 serum and moisturizer and SPF, its fine. It isn't sticky to where I just can't stand it. My skin is dry to balanced and I'm in my 40s so I guess that's "mature' skin. I definitely recommend this if you need to fade dark spots and help with hyperpigmentation! I am so impressed with this serum! Wow!!! Side note… I also use the Urban Skin Rx cleansing bar in the jar with the same color label as thi

Love all their products that I've tried. Finally find a product that actually clears and gives me a healthy Complexion. It's the one.

The smell is off putting but it's worth it. I have been using consistently day and night for 3 weeks and it's already my holy grail. If you're looking for confirmation to get this product this is it.

I have been using this serum daily for the past 4 months and my melasma is almost all gone. Considering the price point of other brands, I was doubtful about it, since it is more affordable, but the result speaks for it.
Just didn't like the product. I use a lot of skin care and this this just didn't do a thing. I will not be repurchasing.

avis.titre: One of the best Vitamin C out there
avis.texte: I have used others but this line definitely helps with dark spots. Will continue to use!!
I love this stuff. I always get compliments on how pretty and glowy my skin looks.

avis.titre: I LOVE the Urban Skin product line
avis.texte: I started with the cleansing bar when I received a free sample. I loved it so much that I decided to try the starter kit since Ive never had an actual skincare routine. The kit included the cleansing bar, super glow serum, daytime moisturizer, and dark spot cream. I used all for a week so far and all of a sudden my face is excessively dry and peeling like I have a sunburn. Did anyone else find this happen to them? I love how the serum gives an instant glow and I found it tingles a little but I do have sensitive skin and I'm wondering if its to harsh for me? After doing my research about the products, I didn't expect this dryness to occur. Anyone else experience this from the serum and/or creams? I know its not the cleansing bar because Ive been using that for a while now.

I definitely see a very noticeable change with my skin. It's brighter and more clear. I can see a few dark pigments have disappeared as well. Which is a first and amazing. I'm greatly pleased. I've been referring everyone. Best thing since Pro-ve.
I absolutely love this product. It definitely gives you a glow.
Love this serum it's definitely a great part of my morning routine!

avis.titre: Who cares about the scent, it works!
avis.texte: Title says it all. Sure, this has a sort of odd smell right out of the bottle, but I timed it and it dissipates in 2 seconds. Who can't deal with it for 2 seconds? It's also really not that bad, its just that it doesn't smell like a bouquet or a baked good. That's fine with me because it means they didnt dillute it with stuff that would make it less effective. Becaise let me tell you, this stuff WORKS! I've got dark spots from sun damage as well as old acne scars and they are noticeably fading already after 2 weeks of daily use. The way I can tell is that my powder foundation now covers one particular dark spot that previously always showed through the powder no matter how much I applied. Yesterday, the spot disappeared with only one layer of powder! For results like this, I can deal with a couple of seconds of an odd smell. I don't smell burnt oranges personally. Depending on what state you live in, you might be reminded of a different scent…

It smells a little weird but I dont mind it. I bought the sample kit a while back and now i bought the full size bottle and i LOVE IT !! I've only been using it for a week and i see my spots lookibg lighter. However, it is strong so if you have sensitive skin i wouldnt recommend.

This smells terrible and is very agitating to sensitive skin. Both i would have dealt with but i cannot accept piling. It doesnt play nice with other skincare. I finished an entire bottle and dont feel the results are worth the price tag. USRX had some really effective products but they are doing lots of formula changes to products that were already drying and unkind to sensitivity. Spend your money elsewhere, theres better stuff out there

This is definitely a must have. You'll find bad reviews for two reasons; reasons that don't bother me. It has a pungent smell, not like perfume, but medicinal. It's sticky like an orange on your skin, but that's what makes your skin feel firm.
I can't imagine not having this product in my life! I use this even tone super serum twice a day. It's my secret goodness facial shine product!

I love this serum. It smells bad but that's how I know it's so good. This is my second bottle and I do see a slow steady improvement of my skin with using this consistently day time only. You get instant gratification with seeing luminosity!

It is great for my skin makes me look years younger and makes me love my look! It's easy to use and gets nicely absorbed. It doesn't leave any oily residue making it very comfortable to wear all day !

Decided to stop using this serum after only five days of using it because it would leave orange marks on my face a few hours after application. It washes off of course, but it's not ideal especially when wearing out. It's a bummer because I loved the glow that the serum gave off!
This product is good on my skin. I can't use the 20% vitamin C because it feels irritated.Please change the bottle so that it's easier to see when the product is getting low.

Show yourself.

Love this product the quality is top notch, it's a part of my morning and nightly routine and has helped repair dark spots and even my tone.

This is one of my favorite products. I've noticed improvements in my overall skin appearance and new blemishes diminish much faster than they used too.

I have really bad dark spots on my back and neck from acne scars. I've tried their bar before and I think it worked but to be honest, I was trying out different products at that time so I didn't know which of them was fading my spots. I picked up this serum and used it in conjunction with a microneedle roller. Let me tell you. Three weeks later and I see a HUGE difference. The only downside is the scent. Some people describe it as burnt orange but to me, it smells like black licorice. Absolutely foul. BUT, I will continue to buy this and use it because I bought it for results, not for the scent.
I like Urban product line but the Super Glow Serum is too much. I like the regular serum better, it's not sticky.

overall, good vitamin C, but I didnt see fabulous enough results to justify the price. the smell is awful, I'll be honest. never experienced irritation or breakouts with it so I'll use it up, but wont repurchase
This product really helps fade my dark spots on my face and neck.

It gives your face an instant glow after one use. I really love this product.

I will give it that! i am seeing fading, but I am unsure if it's due to time, the Even Tone Cleanser, or this. I also bought the Retinol cream which I'm loving. I won't buy this again.

I am amazed that how well this serum has worked on my Melasma. Only a week of use and I have seen a huge difference. It has worked better than 4% hydroquinone cream for me that I have been using for few months with no to very little results. Pls don't change this formula ever to mask the smell. Smell is a very small price pay for the product like that. And I have used almost all the products in the market to treat my malasma and paid thousands of dollars to dematologists. I am glad I finally found something g that I can use on my face safely forever. Thanks so much

When I first bought this product, I absolutely loved it. Yes, the smell was a bit much, but it truly changed my skin. I went through 3-4 bottles of it. Great product. However, with my last order, I noticed some changes. The smell was gone (huge pro) and the top's color was changed to match the bottle. I thought maybe I had gotten a bad order or something because the tint of the actual product was also a lot lighter than usual, but after visiting the store, I saw that they changed the color of the top on all of them. Along with these changes, I noticed one last thing. I'm not sure if the formula has been changed to help with the smell or not, but now I'm experiencing breakouts. Nothing has changed in my facial routine at all. So I'm wondering if with the changes of the product, something else changed? I'm not sure, but I might not be able to continue using this if it's causing more breakouts.
My product didn't come with a dropper and the product smells like beef jerky and nail polish remover.

My skin is not really sensitive but this serum caused a lot of breakouts and pimples. Just for a week of usage, now it's been 4 weeks and I'm still dealing with treatments to fix that. Oh such a waste of money and my time.

My bottle was brand new and sealed. The serum was alot darker than shown. Turned my skin orange. I hope it washes out in the morning. The smell is strange. Ill give it a few tries at night, given it doesn't keep my skin orange

I loveee all of Urbanskinrx products and I have just about every product they have, I started using back in 2020 and my skin has been very clear but recently I had a bad breakout from a new hair products I started using so in the process of getting my skin clear again!
I've using this serum for awhile now, it has my face glowing..I'm always receiving compliments
I absolutely love this serum. It's my go to for pimple scaring,dullness from too much sun and anti aging. This serum along with the 3 in 1 cleansing bar are my favorites from this skincare line.
At first I didn't like this product, I hated the smell and feel of it. HOWEVER, this serum is a gem. Using it consistently has really transformed the surface of my skin.

avis.titre: Great product… the smell ruins it
avis.texte: The product itself does its job. However the smell is awful. At first it smelt like perm solution then I realized it smelt more like salami. Had to rewash my face because I couldn't bare the smell.
I really like this serum but I hate how sticky it makes my face feel.
Omg where do I begin! amazing product if your struggling with dull skin constant breakout then use there product!

This is my first time using the Even Tone Super Glow Serum. It works great and you don't have to use a lot. A little goes a long way due to it's thin liquid form. Save your product. I will be ordering this again. Also, I only use the Even Tone Serum and the Retinol Rapid Repair & Dark Spot Treatment at night. I use Even Tone Cleansing Bar in the morning.

I have been using for 3 weeks now and have noticed a difference in my skin. I will admit that it does smell bad, but the smell dissipates after about 15 minutes. You should also make sure that your face is completely dry after washing before applying because it can sting and burn. I had no problems with it after making sure my sking was completely dry about 20 or 30 minutes after washing and applied in the a.m. I plan to buy again. It has a great combination of ingredients in it for your skin which is why I bought it.

I bought this from Ulta to help with uneven skin tone and some dark spots. I am really loving it so far and will definitely buy it again. I have noticed a difference in my skin tone in just one week of using it. I bought it because of all the excellent ingredients. It's been perfect for very, very fair skin. I plan to try to Super C as well.
This has a little bit of burn to it but it's amazing at rapid repair and even tone recovery. Dark spots and acne spots are disappearing quickly, discoloration is fading.
Love the product so far, been using a week. Great consistency m. I'm pleased so far and will be purchasing again.
It kind of has a funny smell. Don't forget to shake it before you use it. Great results tho

I am a board-certified dermatologist. This is my personal favorite vitamin C serum and the one that I recommend to my patients. This serum contains the exact same, highly-effective combination of ingredients as the gold-standard SkinCeuticals serum, at just a fraction of the cost. It also has additional ingredients that are proven to fight redness and pigmentation issues. Vitamin C is a very difficult product to formulate in a way that's effective and shelf stable. Unfortunately, all of the best serums that use the effective form of vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid) tend to feel tacky and have an unpleasant smell (for example, SkinCeuticals is known to smell like hotdog water)— obviously not ideal, but that's just a small price you pay in order to reap the benefits of a highly beneficial skincare ingredient. If a vitamin C serum doesn't feel slightly tacky or have an odd smell, it likely doesn't contain L-ascorbic acid and therefore, isn't formulated in a way that's effective, shelf stable, or leading to any long term benefit for your skin. As far as vitamin C serums go, I think the smell of this one is actually not bad..even somewhat pleasant. They've done a good job of masking the underlying "hotdog water" smell of all ascorbic acid-containing products. Yes, it goes on slightly tacky, but it eventually dries down and the tackiness goes away after a moisturizer is applied. It works well under my moisturizer, sunscreen, and makeup.
